discountCode.description: A discount code the customer typed; the order is refused when it cannot be used.

saveAddress.description: Also store the delivery address in the user profile.

discountAmount.description: The amount the code takes off the subtotal it was checked with.

DiscountCodeCheckResponse.description: What a code takes off a subtotal, for the cart to preview before the checkout.

code.description: Letters, digits and dashes; stored in upper case.

value.description: The percentage (1-100) or the amount in dollars.

minimumSubtotal.description: The smallest subtotal the code works on; none for any order.

usageLimit.description: How many orders in total may use the code; none for no limit.

DiscountCodeRequest.description: Body of POST and PUT /api/v1/admin/discount-codes. Rules: `DiscountCodeRequestValidator`.

timesUsed.description: Orders the code was applied to.

DiscountCodeResponse.description: A discount code as the admin panel sees it.

paymentDueAt.description: When the order is cancelled if it is still unpaid.

OrderPaymentResponse.description:
The payment of an order, for the payment page: the browser confirms it with a card straight at
the payment service (POST /api/v1/payments/{paymentId}/confirm) before Store.OrderService.DTOs.Responses.OrderPaymentResponse.PaymentDueAt.

subtotal.description: Sum of the lines before discount and delivery.

discountCode.description: The discount code the order was discounted by, if any.

statusHistory.description: Every status the order has been in, oldest first, with the time it changed.

nextStatuses.description: What the administrator can still do with the order: Shipped (once paid), Cancelled (until shipped).

deliveryFrom.description: First and last day of the delivery window promised at checkout; null for older orders.

paymentDueAt.description: When the customer must have paid by; set once the stock is reserved.

cardBrand.description: Brand of the card that paid (visa, mastercard).

cardLast4.description: Last four digits of that card.

cancellationReason.description: Why the order was cancelled: out-of-stock, payment-timed-out or cancelled-by-administrator.

totalCount.description: Rows in the whole listing, not on this page.

OrderResponsePagedResponse.description: One page of a listing, the same shape for every resource.

PaymentStatus.description: Where a payment stands; stored by name, written in camelCase by the APIs.

cardBrand.description: Brand of the card (visa, mastercard), when a card was used

cardLast4.description: Last four digits of the card; the full number is never sent

failureReason.description: For a failed payment: one of Store.Contracts.Payments.V1.PaymentDeclineReasons

PaymentWebhookData.description: The payment an event is about.

id.description: Unique per event; the same when a delivery is retried

PaymentWebhookEvent.description:
What the payment service posts to the order service's webhook when a payment changes, the way
a card provider reports to a shop: JSON in camelCase, signed in the `Store-Signature`
header (`WebhookSignature`). An event may arrive more than once and out of order; its
Id tells a repeat from a new one.

freeDeliveryThreshold.description: Orders with a subtotal (before the discount) at or above this amount ship for free.

firstOrderDiscountPercent.description: Percentage taken off the subtotal of a customer's first order.

deliveryFrom.description: First day an order placed now should arrive on.

deliveryTo.description: Last day an order placed now should arrive on.

PricingRulesResponse.description:
The rules the order service prices an order by, so the cart page can preview the amounts
the same way instead of keeping its own copy of the numbers. The order itself is always
priced here, at checkout.

paidOrders.description: Orders customers paid for and did not have refunded: paid or shipped.

ShopOrderStatsResponse.description: What the shop says about its orders in public (GET /api/v1/orders/stats).

traceId.description: W3C trace id of the request, to find it in the logs.

errors.description: Messages per field of a 422 problem.

StoreProblemDetails.description:
The error response as this store fills it, for the document only: the RFC 9457 members
plus the trace id every problem carries and the field messages of a validation problem.

status.description: The status to move the order to: Shipped or Cancelled.

WebhookReceipt.description: The acknowledgement of a webhook: its id, and whether it had been received before.

Bearer.description: Access token issued by the identity service

tags.name: AdminDiscountCodes
tags.description:
Discount codes in the admin panel. Both administrators see them; only the true one may
create, change or delete a code.

tags.name: AdminOrders
tags.description:
Orders as the admin panel sees them. The demo administrator sees the panel but not the
customers' data.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: The signed-in customer's orders. The admin panel has its own routes under /admin/orders.

tags.name: PaymentWebhooks
tags.description:
Where the payment service reports payments. Not routed by the gateway - only the payment
service on the internal network reaches it - and trusted only with a valid signature, which a
filter checks before the body is bound.
